verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents the self-serve pieces of this story: a free CRM with no expiration to sign up for, multi-object import of companies and deals with associations, a self-service transfer for moving existing CRM data, and automatic deduplication. Together these support getting real data in without an implementation partner. However, nothing evidences the under-an-hour timeframe or the pipeline setup itself. missing for 10: evidence of signup-to-working-pipeline in under an hour, documentation of deal pipeline/stage configuration during onboarding, hands-on or independent corroboration of the self-serve migration experience.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: If you're new to HubSpot and want to transfer your existing CRM data to HubSpot's CRM, you can use self-service transfer to audit and sync your data
You can import records such as companies or deals, as well as activities like calls or meetings, and create associations between them.
And unlike a free trial, it's 100% free with no expiration date.
HubSpot automatically deduplicates contacts using email addresses, and companies using domain names.
